Telephone Sign Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Telephone Sign because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+2121, which you can use as ℡ in HTML, \2121 in CSS, or type with Alt+8481 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Telephone Sign is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+2121 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Telephone Sign has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ℡ or the hex escape ℡.

How to type telephone sign on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 8 4 8 1 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 8481.
  4. Release Alt. The Telephone Sign character (℡) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type telephone sign on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Telephone Sign. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Telephone Sign" and click the character to insert it.

How to use telephone sign in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\2121"; ()
  • Python: \u2121 or chr(0x2121)
  • JavaScript: \u2121 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2121)
  • JSON: "\u2121"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ℡?

No legacy Alt code exists for Telephone Sign because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+2121 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ℡ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ℡, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8481 not work?

Alt+8481 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Telephone Sign?

The Unicode codepoint for Telephone Sign is U+2121. You can use this value in HTML as ℡, in CSS as \2121, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ℡ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2121, then click it.
